paragraphs.text: Saved time is not the work.

surveyed 521 UX practitioners. Access is nearly universal and the tasks get faster, but the average feeling is 3.57 out of 5 and most written comments were negative. People use it most for desk work and least for work with users.
pointed at the empty box. He set his site to answer before anyone asks, because the hard part of an AI product is knowing what it can do. A faster draft does not explain itself.
separates speed from the language. Most of the wait is the database, the disk, or another service. A faster language does not remove that wait.
